notes:
CRM: Differs from Zoho: TAVI lets you edit another field on an old record that already breaks a newer rule (200), and refuses only when the checked field is changed. Zoho CRM (live) refuses the save even when only another field (Title) is changed
DESK: record saved as BAD-old while rule off (201); rule back on; edit a DIFFERENT field -> 200; edit the checked field to another bad value -> 422
DESK: TAVI Desk: same as CRM (other field edit 200, checked field change 422)
